label: NOT_EVIDENCE_VALIDATION_PROTOCOL
provenance_caveat: Protocol + power calculation only. NOT performance evidence. The protocol defines what a future GO decision requires; it does not validate the strategy, and it never relabels partial, cross-venue, or synthetic data.

decision_lock.reason: Retained Hyperliquid window is a partial 161-day window with only 4 distinct crash days and 2 traded episodes; the power floor is >=10 independent crash episodes. No achievable API window can reach the floor, and no cross-venue, partial, dry-run, or synthetic artifact may be promoted to evidence.
decision_lock.continue_only_with: an operator-supplied, C4-T1-validated, Hyperliquid-native archive covering at least the duration computed below (>=10 independent crash episodes), ingested through the DATA_REQUEST runbook
forbidden_relabelings: the exploratory spec-literal fan-out as validation

primary_endpoint.name: episode_level_net_pnl
primary_endpoint.definition: Net PnL of one crash episode (all positions opened by that episode's crash-day signal, including ETH hedge legs, funding, fees, slippage, and liquidation penalties), aggregated per independent episode
primary_endpoint.test: two-sided 95% episode-block bootstrap CI on the mean episode PnL
primary_endpoint.go_rule: bootstrap 95% CI excludes 0 in the positive direction

secondary_endpoints.name: episode_win_rate
secondary_endpoints.definition: fraction of independent episodes with positive net PnL

secondary_endpoints.name: max_drawdown
secondary_endpoints.definition: peak-to-trough equity drawdown across the episode sequence

secondary_endpoints.name: rebound_short_profit_share
secondary_endpoints.go_rule: reported, not a GO gate (spec target ~27%, not a validity test)

episode_clustering_rule.rule: Collapse all crash signals within 72h on the same UTC crash day into one episode; an episode counts once regardless of how many symbols fired. Independence requires distinct crash days.
episode_clustering_rule.independence_requirement: Episodes on the same crash day are NOT independent (shared market move). Inference uses crash-day blocks, never raw trade counts.

bootstrap.method: stationary block bootstrap over crash-day blocks

permutation.null: episode PnL is exchangeable across crash days (no crash-day effect)

placebo.method: full-portfolio placebo over all signal-gate events
placebo.detail: Enumerate exact subsets of signal-gate events where feasible; otherwise Monte Carlo over event subsets, replaying the real engine.
placebo.go_rule: canonical result is not an extreme of the placebo distribution (one-sided p < 0.05 against the placebo mean)

multiple_testing.rule: GO requires the primary endpoint to survive Holm correction across the family

power_calculation.method: Poisson episode arrivals; bisection solve for duration D at target power

archive_requirement.note: The spec window is only 283 days; reaching 80% power needs a longer archive than the spec window, which is exactly why the operator archive must be multi-year.

GO: >= 10 independent crash episodes on distinct crash days
all inputs C4-T1 validated Hyperliquid-native, non-synthetic, checksummed
NO_GO: any input is partial, cross-venue, synthetic, or unchecksummed
stop_go_rules.current_status: NO_GO (retained partial window; floor unreachable on API data)

okx_cross_venue_note.statement: OKX is cross-venue and is never Hyperliquid evidence.
